content:
Emily Chen: Hey team — Finrise POC needs SOC2 + ISO excerpts + signed pen-test letter by EOD Mon (customer legal). Also they're asking if we can upload the evidence bundle to their S3 or share presigned links.

Raj Patel: We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II PDF + ISO27001 scope excerpt. Signed pen-test letter requires Security + Legal coordination (need customer legal name + scope). ETA: 48–72h once we have the PO.

Matt O'Neill: FYI dedicated capacity will bump the monthly quote. Do we have a quick delta for a 2-GPU reserved pool for the 4-week POC? Sales needs an estimate for the SOW tomorrow.

Emily Chen: They want the cost impact now — even a ballpark helps. Can someone drop a number?

Raj Patel: Rough ballpark: ~"$7.5k/mo" for 2x A10G-equivalent reserved, plus ~"$1.2k" one-time provisioning. I'll confirm exact SKU/pricing with ops this afternoon.

Sara Gómez: Can we split artifact delivery? e.g., SOC2 + ISO today, pen-test letter once signed. Customer is ok with partial drop.

security-bot: Artifact bundle uploaded: https://redwood-files.example.com/dl/finrise-evidence-2741598230 (expires in 7 days)

Emily Chen: Nice — what's in that bundle? small list pls

Raj Patel: Inside: redacted_soc2_type2_2024.pdf, iso27001_scope_excerpt.pdf, evidence_index.csv, pen-test-letter-template.docx (unsigned). We won't upload directly to customer S3; we can issue presigned URLs per file.

Matt O'Neill: For the SOW, call out that dedicated pricing above is estimate and subject to final SKU selection and term. Also note that enabling VPC/private deployment may add a setup window of ~48h.

Emily Chen: Any blocker for Security to sign the pen-test letter once Legal has the PO?

Raj Patel: No blockers technically. Legal needs to sign off on the scope language. Once Legal confirms, Security can sign and date the letter within ~48h. Please attach the customer PO and legal name to the request.

Sara Gómez: I'll ask the customer for legal entity name + scope and request PO now. Ping me when you update the template.

Emily Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll include the presigned link and the pricing estimate in the SOW and send to Finrise. Will follow up here after customer confirms. :thumbsup:
